title: Type 1 Diabetes
definition: Autoimmune destruction of insulin production demands lifelong insulin — now delivered by pumps and guided by CGMs. Management is math plus vigilance. Technology transformed T1D from burden to manageable.
patient_flow: Referrals come for uncontrolled diabetes, thyroid nodules, or hormone mysteries; workup blends labs, imaging, and dynamic testing. Diabetes patients enter education programs — pumps and CGMs fitted, skills taught. Inpatient teams manage DKA and glycemic control hospital-wide. Longitudinal clinics tune therapy for life with annual complication screening.
code_demo:
def insulin_correction(current_bg, target_bg, correction_factor):
    """Correction insulin dose estimator (for education; verify with provider)."""
    if current_bg <= target_bg: return "No correction needed"
    units = (current_bg - target_bg) / correction_factor
    return f"Correction: ~{units:.1f} units (1 unit per {correction_factor} mg/dL over target)"
print(insulin_correction(240, 120, 40))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
